name: airship-rtds-data-collection-audit
description: Airship RTDS Data Collection Audit — capture a tracking-only RTDS stream and generate the tagging plan (.xlsx / .json)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.setup:local: npm run install:all && mkdir -p config && (test -f server/.env || cp server/.env.example server/.env) && (test -f frontend/.env.local || cp frontend/.env.local.example frontend/.env.local)
scripts.serve: npm run build && npm start --prefix server
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix server && npm run test --prefix frontend
